1073.d: Ape Atoll is an island that is located in southern Gielinor.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
There are four ways of getting to Ape Atoll:
• Travelling via Daero at the floor 2 of the Grand Tree (east next to Blurberry), then talking to Waydar who will take you to Crash Island, and then sailing to Ape Atoll by talking to Lumdo.
• The teleportation spell Ape Atoll Teleport, requiring level 64 Magic (after completing the King Awowogei part of Recipe for Disaster).
• Teleporting to the Agility course using the fairy ring code CLR (after completing A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift). A small ninja monkey greegree is required to get through the log shortcut to the agility course and the rest of the island.
• Superior locator Special log teleport (1/8 chance, requires visiting Ape Atoll once, during Monkey Madness)
• Using a spirit tree to teleport to an evil tree on the south part of the island, which is not recommended due to its unreliability.

1074.d: The Ape Atoll Agility Course is located near Marim, Ape Atoll.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Players can use the Ape Atoll Teleport spell to reach a location close to the course; this requires completion of the Recipe for Disaster subquest, Freeing King Awowogei.
• Players who have completed A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift can use fairy ring code CLR to teleport directly to the course.
• The player must first clear the log (no items required to clear) and use a small ninja greegree to go through. This will take players to the middle of the course; swing the rope to cross the river, then climb down the tropical tree to the beginning of the course.

1125.d: Arandar, also called the Arandar Range and known by the gnomes as the Galarpos Mountains, is a mountain range in western Kandarin which separates Tirannwn from the rest of Gielinor.

1126.d: Arandar Pass, commonly referred to as just Arandar, is a mountain pass through Arandar, granting passage between Kandarin and Tirannwn that may be used by players upon completion of the Regicide quest.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Teleport to the World Gate using the Sixth-Age circuit, and proceed southeast.
• Teleport to the Eagles' Peak lodestone, then proceed south. 
• Teleport to the Ardougne lodestone, then proceed west past the overpass toward the mountains.
• Teleport to the Tree Gnome Stronghold, exit via the south gate, and proceed southwest.
• Teleport to the Outpost using the Traveller's necklace, then proceed west.

1127.d: The Arandar Pass mine is located to the north of the exit from the pass in Tirannwn and to the east of Prifddinas' eastern wall.

gt.heading: Travel
gt.text:
• Follow the Arandar Pass south, (utilising the shortcuts if you wish) from either the east Prifddinas gate or from the gate south of Eagles' Peak.
• Using the Sixth-Age circuit to teleport to the World Gate and running south.
• Starting from the entrance to the Underground Pass, north of Lletya, go north through the dense forest. Take the log balance across the water and step-over the tripwire. The mining site is then to the north-east, with no further obstacles.

1188.d: Archaeology banner is found in the Max Guild garden.

1189.d: The Archaeology Campus is an area east of Varrock.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Walking to the east from Varrock lodestone.
• Using Ancient Magicks player can teleport to the entrance of the Senntisten Temple.
• Dig Site pendant can teleport player to various locations around the Campus.
• Archaeology teleport and Master archaeologist's outfit can both teleport the user to Campus.
• Archaeology journal teleports the user directly to the Archaeology Guild.

1190.d: The Archaeology Guild is located in the Archaeology Campus.

1191.d: Archaeology Guild banners are scenery objects found at Archaeology dig sites.
1191.ex: Marks an official Archaeology Guild dig site.
